title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop. This loop includes four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0411, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.0411, 0.0) and ends at (0.0411, 0.0411); the third line starts at (0.0411, 0.0411) and ends at (0.0, 0.0411); the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0411) and returns to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0411 to ensure the correct proportions. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by applying a rotation with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body. The resulting dimensions are 0.0411 meters in length, 0.0411 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.box(0.0411, 0.0411, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# The final model is represented as 'r'
